Wisp CSS

Extending

Wisp is built around CSS layers, making it easy to extend with your own classes.

Foundation

Basic typography. 

@layer foundation { ... }

Objects

Structural objects. 

@layer objects { ... }

Components

Reusable UI patterns. 

@layer components { ... }

Behaviors

Interactions and behaviors patterns. 

@layer behaviors { ... }

Utilities

One-off helper classes. 

@layer utilities { ... }
